lines.maoEnglish:
Thum, th-thum, thum.
“…”
The rhythm returns, and somehow my lungs begin working again.
“―――――――――”
One night alone has left me terribly weak.
My sight swims in a gray haze.
Even the air hurts where it touches my skin.
My organs are beginning to fail; if I stop concentrating on each breath, the rhythm tangles and threatens to cease.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま、起きていらっしゃいますか……？」
　翡翠の声。
　……これで何度目だろう。
翡翠は、本当にこりない。
「起きてらっしゃるのでしょう？
　それでしたら、せめてお食事をおとりになってください」
「……いい。
翡翠たちが持ってくるものは、食べない」
　何も食べない。
　この家で出されるものは何も信用できない。
　食べ物も。
水も。
薬も。
　自分を殺そうとするための、毒に思える。
lines.label: s408
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, are you awake…?”
Hisui’s voice.
How many times has this been? She truly never gives up.
“You are awake, aren’t you? Then please, at least eat something.”
“No. I won’t eat anything you bring me.”
I will eat nothing.
Nothing served in this house can be trusted.
Food. Water. Medicine.
All of it feels like poison meant to kill me.

「………」
　ごん、と壁に頭を打ち付ける。
　……こうして翡翠を無視するのは何回目だろう。
　……翡翠。
翡翠は秋葉や琥珀さんとは違う。
　翡翠は俺のことを殺そうとはしていないかもしれない。

“…”
I knock my head against the wall.
How many times have I ignored her like this?
Hisui. She isn’t like Akiha or Kohaku.
Maybe Hisui isn’t trying to kill me.

「――――は、あ」
　……だめだ。
　自分で自分の思考がとりとめのない、被害妄想じみている事は分かっている。
　なのに、いまさら思考は正常には戻ってくれない。
lines.label: s408
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
But that is a delusion.
Hisui tried to confine me to this room.
Even now she keeps coming back to spy on me, making sure I remain locked inside.
“――――Hah.”
This is hopeless.
I know my thoughts are incoherent, paranoid.
Yet knowing it can no longer make them sane.

　トントン、トントンという繰り返し。
「……志貴さま。

「……秋葉さまも姉さんも、今日はお出かけになって戻られないそうです。
今、この屋敷にはわたしと志貴さましかおりません」
　だから外に出て来い、とでも言いたいのか。
「うるさい……！
　俺にかまうなって言ってるのに、どうしてわからないんだ翡翠は……！」
「――――――――」
　息を飲む気配。
　翡翠の気配が遠くなっていく。
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:
Another knock.
Tap-tap, tap-tap—the same patient refrain.
“Master Shiki. Your meal has gone cold.”
Her voice is sorrowful.
“Miss Akiha and my sister have gone out for the day and will not be returning. Master Shiki and I are the only people in the mansion now.”
Is that supposed to coax me outside?
“Shut up…! I told you to leave me alone, so why can’t you understand, Hisui…!”
“――――――――”
I hear her catch her breath.
Hisui’s presence receded.

新しい環境に連れてこられて、周りの人間に馴染めずに一人でずっと閉じこもっていた子供の頃。
　とにかく何もかもが嫌で、誰とも話したくなかった。
　そんな時に、何度もドアを叩いてきた少女がいた。
　トントン、というノック音。
　だれだ、と俺が聞くたびに、「あたしだよ」
と答えてくる声。
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:
When I was a child, I was brought to a strange new place and, unable to fit in with the people there, shut myself away.
I hated everything and wanted to speak to no one.
And then there was the girl who came and knocked on my door again and again.
Tap-tap.
Whenever I asked who was there, a voice answered “It’s me” from beyond the door.

Knock, knock, was the sound.
Every time I would ask who it was, the voice would always respond "It's me."

"…… Old letters?
Why?"
The handwriting is definitely my old man's.
It's fragmented and I can't understand it at first glance.
---The date starts in the summer of eight years ago and seems to continue on a little past that.

"…………"
I don't understand it yet, but I continue leafing through it.

~ Month ~ Day
My son SHIKI succumbed to his Tohno blood.
SHIKI, he killed my adopted son who happened to be there.
(The adopted son is the heir of the house Nanaya. I guess it is a blessing in all the unfortunate events that he isn't in the same family as the Synchronizers, like Kohaku and Hisui.)
SHIKI's inversion impulse is terrible.
So it was determined that he must be eliminated.
I have my duty as the head of the Tohno household, but killing my own son is so difficult.

「……ん……」
　中には古びた日記帳と、便箋らしきものがあるだけだった。
　日記帳は子供用のもので、もう一つは誰かにあてた手紙の原文らしい。
「……手紙の原文って、どうして」
　筆跡は間違いなく親父のものだ。
　内容はひどく断片的で、一見してなんの事だかわからない。
―――日付は、八年前の夏の日から始まって、その後は少しずつ月日が経過しているようだ。

「…………」
　意味がわからないまでも、とりあえず目を通してみることにする。

〇月〇日。
　息子のシキが遠野の血に傾斜する。
　シキ、その場に居あわせた養子を殺害。
（養子は七夜の跡取り息子である。
琥珀、翡翠といった感応者の一族ではないのは不幸中の幸いだった）
　シキは反転が酷い。
よって処罰するしかないと判断した。
遠野の当主の役割といえ、我が子を殺すのは辛い。

lines.japanese:
遠野の血は、アキハよりシキのほうが濃い。
　潜在的なレヴェルではアキハにより旧い起源を感じるが、血の濃さではシキが上回っていた。
　そのために、シキは成人する前に反転してしまったのだろう。
　シキの能力は『不死』と『共融』である。
　シキは蘇った自己の能力を持て余し、結果として近くにいた七夜の養子を殺害し、その命を奪い取った。
　初めての能力行使にしては素晴らしいと言わざるをえまい。
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:
The Tohno blood runs more strongly in SHIKI than in Akiha.
On a latent level I sense an older Origin in Akiha, but SHIKI’s blood is the more concentrated.
That must be why he underwent Inversion before reaching adulthood.
SHIKI possesses ‘immortality’ and ‘coalescence.’
Unable to control the powers that awakened when he revived, he killed the nearby Nanaya adoptee and took the boy’s life for himself.
For a first exercise of his abilities, the result was undeniably impressive.

　よって、危険ではあるが処罰するのを止め、遠野の屋敷から一時的に隔離する事にしたい。

Month X, Day X
Both SHIKI and the adopted child have survived.
Before I killed him, SHIKI had already taken the boy’s life force and appears to have used the boy’s remaining years to resurrect himself.
Perhaps because he came so near death, some measure of reason has returned from his Inversion.
Though he remains dangerous, I will stay his punishment and isolate him from the Tohno mansion for the present.

七夜の養子のほうは、命をとりとめたといっても長くは持つまい。
　仮に回復したとしても、シキに命を奪われている身である。
いつ頓死してもおかしくない体だ。
　養子は生きているかぎりシキと意識が同調してしまう可能性がある。
シキと命を共有するが故の副作用だろう。
だが、そうなってしまえばいずれ養子は衰弱死する。
問題はない。
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:
As for the Nanaya adoptee, survival does not mean he has long to live.
Even if he recovers, SHIKI has already taken his life. His body may fail without warning.
While the boy lives, his consciousness may synchronize with SHIKI’s. This is presumably a side effect of their shared life. Should that occur, the adopted child will eventually waste away and die. It presents no difficulty.

As long as the adopted child lives, there is a possibility that his mind will be attuned with SHIKI's.
It seems it is a side effect of their two lives being linked.

lines.maoEnglish:
Month X, Day X
The public account remains to be settled.
SHIKI killed the Nanaya adoptee.
The facts have been concealed, but SHIKI cannot appear in public. The wounds I inflicted have yet to heal, and his very form has changed.

The Nanaya adoptee remains alive.
As long as that thing survives, I intend to put it to use.
If there are objections, I request a reply.

補足。
　七夜の血筋は、ある種殺人鬼を輩出する一族である。
　もしあの養子が生き残ってしまった場合、命を共有して繋がっているシキに悪影響を及ぼすだろう。
　せっかく理性を取り戻したシキが、七夜の養子に引きずられて『殺人鬼』になってしまう可能性も否定できない。
　そのような事態が起きないよう、養子は目の届く範囲で飼わなければならない。
だが遠野の屋敷に近づける事も許されない。
　管理に適切な分家筋を選んでほしい。

lines.maoEnglish:
Addendum.
The Nanaya bloodline produces a particular breed of killer.
If the adopted child survives, his bond of shared life may exert a harmful influence upon SHIKI.
SHIKI has only just regained his reason; we cannot dismiss the possibility that the Nanaya boy will drag him into becoming a “murderer.”
To prevent that outcome, the adopted child must be kept on a short leash and under observation. He must not, however, be allowed anywhere near the Tohno mansion.
Select a suitable branch family to manage him.

Ordinarily, I would laugh at the idea.
But now it explains far too much.

"……… Ah, I see."
Ten years ago.
The Japanese style house nestled deep within the mountains.
Surrounded by a black forest, a rustic world isolated from the flow of history.
…… I can't, quite, remember it well.
All I can remember is that pale, blue glass moon.
And in the forest's clearing, a figure that looked like Tohno Makihisa was cutting up lots of people.

lines.japanese:

　そんな終わってしまった事なんて、どうでもいい話だろう。

lines.mirrorMoon:

lines.japanese:
「……それで。
俺がここでシキってヤツに殺されたのはわかった。
けど、どうしてその俺が生きていて遠野志貴なんて立場になってるんだ。
俺には、そのあたりがよくわからない」
「……はい。
たしかに志貴さまはシキに胸を貫かれて瀕死の状態になりました。
けれどその後、志貴さまは奇跡的に一命を取りとめたのです。
　志貴さまは助かり、槙久さまに処罰されたシキも一命を取りとめた。
　誰も死ななかったのですから、事はそれで終わる筈でした。
けれどシキはもう人前に出れるカタチをしていなかったんです」
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:

“Yes. SHIKI pierced Master Shiki’s chest and left him at the brink of death. Yet by some miracle, Master Shiki survived.
Master Shiki survived, and SHIKI also survived the punishment Master Makihisa inflicted upon him.
No one had died, so the matter should have ended there. But SHIKI no longer possessed a form that could be shown in public.”

You were saved and SHIKI also survived.

遠野槙久は一企業のトップだしな。
その息子が突然いなくなった、じゃ言い訳がきかない」
「……はい。
槙久さまは事故で死んだのは七夜という養子の子として処理し、志貴さまを遠野志貴として扱いました。
……あくまで、遠野家の体面を守るためだけに」
「……ふぅん。
なるほど、あの親父のやりそうなことだ」
lines.label: s409
lines.maoEnglish:
“So they needed someone to take SHIKI Tohno’s place. Makihisa Tohno headed a company. He could not simply announce that his son had vanished.”
“Yes. Master Makihisa declared the adopted Nanaya child to be the one who died in the accident and presented Master Shiki as Shiki Tohno. Solely to preserve the Tohno family’s reputation.”
“Huh. I see, that sounds exactly like him.”

"…… Yes.
Makihisa-sama pretended that the Nanaya child died, and had you live as Tohno Shiki…… It was all to protect the family name."
"…… I get it, it's something the old man would do."

遠野の後継ぎは血を引いている秋葉以外、もういない。

lines.maoEnglish:

Even if they call me Shiki Tohno, I am not a Tohno. Akiha is the only blood heir the family has left.
So my father sent me to live with the Arima family and manufactured a convenient fiction: the eldest son still lived but was too frail to inherit.

“Compared with Master Shiki or my sister, I have suffered nothing…!
Even after Master Makihisa died, Miss Akiha protected our position in this household.
I alone have lived peacefully all this time, knowing nothing!”

lines.maoEnglish:
“Wait, Hisui.

But to Miss Akiha, Master Shiki is her only brother.
Master Makihisa ordered Miss Akiha almost every day to forget Master Shiki.
But Miss Akiha never agreed, not once. However severely Master Makihisa scolded her, Miss Akiha went on waiting for Master Shiki and no one else.”

「……本当の事を知られたら志貴さまは遠野の家から離れてしまう。
だから志貴さまには真実は決して話さないでほしい、と秋葉さまはわたしたちに頭をおさげになりました。

姉さんは槙久さま付きの使用人で、槙久さまのお部屋から出る事は許されなかった。
それを嫌って、姉さんを自由にしてくれたのは秋葉さまです。
　ですから―――秋葉さまがそう望むのなら、わたしも姉さんもこの嘘をつきとおしたかった。
秋葉さま同様、わたしたちも、志貴さまには帰ってきてほしかったから」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Miss Akiha believed Master Shiki would leave the Tohno family if he learned the truth. She bowed her head to us and begged us never to tell Master Shiki.
My sister and I both owe Miss Akiha a great deal. My sister was Master Makihisa’s servant and forbidden to leave Master Makihisa’s room. Miss Akiha was the one who set my sister free.
So―――if keeping this lie was what Miss Akiha wanted, my sister and I wished to preserve it too. Like Miss Akiha, we wanted Master Shiki to come home.”

Akiha-sama hated that and freed Nee-san.

While still living, he had everything that constituted ‘SHIKI Tohno’ taken from him by Master Shiki, becoming no one at all—something that did not exist.”

lines.maoEnglish:
The metallic whine rings out again.
It comes from higher still—perhaps the fourth floor.
“That idiot!”
I charge past the third-floor landing.
Damn her—how can Akiha do something so reckless?
I know SHIKI better than anyone; I have lived through him in my dreams.
His physical abilities are beyond comparison with any human being’s. I don’t know how inhuman the Tohnos can become, but Akiha can never defeat him. Going alone is no different from offering herself up to be toyed with.
